features.name: Project scaffold and git init
features.notes: Created root .gitignore (Python, Node, env, logs, macOS artifacts). Scaffolded api/ (app/models, schemas, routers, services, alembic/versions, tests with all placeholder .py files) and web/ (src/app routes, components, lib). Git already initialized (root commit on main). No application logic — empty/minimal placeholders only.

features.name: FastAPI setup — config, database, main
features.notes: Created pyproject.toml, .env.example, app/config.py, app/database.py, app/main.py, app/deps.py, and app/__init__.py. Added APIRouter stubs to all 6 router files and a foundation smoke test in tests/test_app.py. Created backend venv and installed dev dependencies. Final verified commands from api/: ruff pass, mypy pass, pytest pass. Test bootstrap no longer depends on an untracked local .env because tests seed required env vars in conftest.py before importing app.config.

features.name: JWT auth — login endpoint and token verification
features.notes: app/auth.py: bcrypt hashing (hash_password, verify_password), JWT encode/decode (create_access_token, verify_token). app/routers/auth.py: POST /auth/login returns JWT on valid credentials, 401 on bad creds; GET /auth/me protected test endpoint. tests/test_auth.py: 3 tests (login success, wrong password → 401, protected endpoint without token → 401). Switched from passlib[bcrypt] to bcrypt directly (passlib incompatible with bcrypt>=5).

features.name: SQLAlchemy models and initial Alembic migration
features.notes: Models: Book (books, authors JSONB, Mapped[list[str]]), Tag + BookTag (tags, book_tags, ondelete=CASCADE on book_id, RESTRICT on tag_id), Loan (loans, book_id ondelete undefined — open decision for back-008), LabelTemplate (label_templates). SQLAlchemy 2 typed ORM with UUID PKs, timezone-aware datetimes. Alembic: alembic.ini, async env.py, concrete 0001_initial_schema.py (5 tables, FKs with ondelete rules, index on books.isbn_13). Added bcrypt to pyproject.toml. Corrective pass (2026-05-25): typed authors as list[str], aligned to JSONB, made FK ondelete policies explicit.

features.name: pytest async fixtures with isolated test database
features.notes: tests/conftest.py: test_engine (session-scoped, drop/create schema), db_session, client (ASGITransport, DB override), auth_client (pre-authenticated). Test database created: personal_library_test on local PostgreSQL 18 (Homebrew).

features.name: ISBN EAN-13 validation and normalization
features.notes: services/isbn_validate.py: normalize_isbn() strips spaces/hyphens, returns digits-only for valid 10/13 digit shapes (full digit check), None otherwise. validate_isbn13() implements EAN-13 checksum. 7 unit tests pass (corrective pass 2026-05-25: fixed partial digit check bug).

features.name: ISBN lookup — Open Library with Google Books fallback
features.notes: services/isbn_lookup.py: BookData dataclass, lookup_isbn() (Open Library first, Google Books fallback), async httpx with 10s timeout. Google Books includes API key only if settings.google_books_api_key is set. Broad exception handling returns None. 3 respx-mocked integration tests pass.

features.name: Books CRUD with ISBN lookup endpoint
features.notes: schemas/book.py: BookCreate, BookUpdate, BookOut, TagOut. routers/books.py: POST /books/ (201 + tag attach), GET /books/ (list with search/language/tag_id filters), GET /books/{id}, PATCH /books/{id} (partial update, tag replacement), DELETE /books/{id} (204), GET /books/lookup/{isbn} (validate + look up + fill isbn_13 from input). 12 tests pass (9 ORM, 3 HTTP with mocked lookup). Infrastructure: test_engine switched to function scope to fix asyncpg event-loop mismatch.

features.name: Tags and loans CRUD
features.notes: schemas/tag.py: TagCreate, TagUpdate, TagOut. schemas/loan.py: LoanCreate, LoanReturn, LoanOut. routers/tags.py: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /tags/, graceful 409 on delete of in-use tag (passive_deletes=True on Tag.book_tags). routers/loans.py: POST /loans/ (validates book_id exists), GET /loans/ (ordered desc, open_only filter), POST /loans/{id}/return (defaults returned_at to UTC now). 12 HTTP tests pass. loans.book_id delete policy: resolved as implicit RESTRICT (preserves loan history, DB rejects book delete with active loans).

features.name: Label templates and PDF generation
features.notes: schemas/label_template.py: LabelTemplateCreate/Out, LabelGenerateRequest. services/pdf_labels.py: generate_labels_pdf with ReportLab Canvas + Code128 barcodes. routers/labels.py: POST/GET /labels/templates/, DELETE /labels/templates/{id}, POST /labels/generate (returns application/pdf). 8 HTTP tests pass (template CRUD, PDF generation, 404 edge cases).

features.name: BibTeX and CSV export
features.notes: services/bibtex_io.py: generate_bibtex(books) using bibtexparser (1.4 API: BibDatabase + dumps), cite keys from first author surname + year, deduplication. services/csv_io.py: generate_csv(books) using csv stdlib, 14-column output, and spreadsheet formula-prefix sanitization. routers/export.py: GET /export/csv (text/csv), GET /export/bibtex (application/x-bibtex), both with Content-Disposition and Cache-Control: private, no-store headers, auth required, ordered by title. tests/test_export.py: 7 HTTP tests — CSV with books, CSV formula sanitization, CSV empty, BibTeX with books, BibTeX empty, auth required for both endpoints.

features.name: CSV and BibTeX import
features.notes: services/csv_io.py: parse_csv() + map_csv_row_to_book_data() parse CSV content and map rows to book fields (authors from '; ' split, optional int fields, empty-header rejection, https-only cover_url, ISBN shape normalization with invalid values dropped). services/bibtex_io.py: parse_bibtex() uses bibtexparser.loads (1.4 API, filters to @book entries only) + map_bibtex_entry_to_book_data() maps author/year/isbn/publisher/language/note and normalizes valid ISBN-10/ISBN-13 values. schemas/import_result.py: ImportResult {total, created, errors, books}. routers/import_.py: POST /import/csv (multipart .csv file, UTF-8) and POST /import/bibtex (multipart .bib file, UTF-8), both auth-only, with streaming 1 MB upload cap and 5,000 record cap. Rows/entries missing 'title' are skipped with error entries. tests/test_import.py: 21 HTTP tests pass (CSV with books, missing title, empty, empty header rejected, auth required, wrong extension, extra columns, oversized upload, too many rows, non-UTF-8, cover_url scheme filtering, invalid ISBNs dropped; BibTeX with books, hyphenated ISBN-13, invalid ISBNs dropped, filters articles, empty, auth required, wrong extension, malformed, missing title). QA approved; Security verdict CLEAN after actionable advisories were fixed.
